questions.question: What does chapter 17 describe?
options: A great and decisive battle against the Philistines
Micah's household idols and a hired Levite priest
The anointing and crowning of Israel's first king
A severe famine that drove a family away to Moab
questions.answer: Micah's household idols and a hired Levite priest

questions.question: What refrain explains the disorder of these chapters?
options: "The people forgot the LORD their God and served all the Baals of the land"
"There was no king in Israel; everyone did what was right in his own eyes"
"The land had rest for forty years under the hand of the judge"
"In those days a great famine spread across the whole of the land"
questions.answer: "There was no king in Israel; everyone did what was right in his own eyes"

questions.question: Micah hired a wandering Levite to be his personal priest.
In those days there was no _____ in Israel; everyone did what was right in his own eyes.
Micah made an idol and a shrine and installed a _____ as his priest.
